independent_controls.scope: Synthetic HTTP, durable write-ack uncertainty and actual moto Decimal callback enforcement; no live service.

findings.finding: Corroborated correctness review: response JSON parsing precedes the exact HTTP413 branch. A JSON decoder RecursionError bypasses the limited ValueError/TypeError handling and classify converts it to generic ProviderResponseError, losing the durable413 review route.
findings.required_change: Branch on explicit HTTP413 before parsing its response body; preserve a no-body-parse synthetic negative control.

findings.finding: Corroborated correctness review: known guest caller gets actionable buttons but the neutral notice does not identify the guest bot and person those actions affect. Replying to the original bot message alone can obscure the actual ban target.
findings.required_change: Use existing escaped BOT/TARGET mention helper with neutral guest-specific wording and the caveat that invoking a bot does not prove malicious intent; missing caller still has no actions.
